title: Spicy Thai Sushi Rolls
description: A unique fusion of Japanese sushi and Thai flavors, these rolls are filled with spicy goodness. Perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to package instructions.
In a small pan, heat the peanut sauce over low heat.
Add the sriracha sauce to the peanut sauce and stir well.
Cut the crab stick into small pieces and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix the cooked sushi rice and crab stick pieces together.
Add the egg to the bowl and mix well.
Lay a sheet of sushi nori flat on a cutting board.
Spread a thin layer of the rice mixture onto the nori.
Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat or a clean tea towel.
Slice the roll into 8 equal pieces.
Serve with the spicy peanut sauce on the side.
